propositions: A Jira issue's KEY changes when moved between projects, but its numeric id remains immutable; bindings keyed on KEY can silently detach when the old key becomes unresolvable if the moved_issue_key table is not updated by third-party movers.
The absence probe incorrectly retires issues that are reachable by their numeric id but not by their stale key, orphaning live tickets.

The binding store must persist the numeric jira_id alongside the key and fall back to id-based lookup when key resolution fails, re-keying the binding and updating the reverse index if the issue's key has changed.
Bindings written before this change (lacking a recorded jira_id) must continue to work unchanged without requiring migration, degrading safely by omitting the id fallback.
The id fallback must not execute while the key resolves normally, avoiding double the cost of the absence probe on the happy path.
Cloud bindings remain unchanged; no existing jira_key-taking method changes signature, and the identity semantics of the shared store remain key-based for compatibility.
